label: Stock subscriptions
description: Customers waiting to be emailed when an out-of-stock product or variant is available again.

email.label: Email
email.description: Address the back-in-stock email is sent to.

variant_id.label: Variant ID
variant_id.description: Set when the customer subscribed to a specific variant.

status.label: Status
status.description: waiting: not yet emailed. notified: the back-in-stock email was triggered. cancelled: the customer or an admin cancelled it.

source.label: Source
source.description: Where the subscription came from, for example "storefront".

types.description: The subscription's status changed to notified.
